description: publish makes a diagram readable by anyone at its link; unpublish makes it private. link makes a share link showing its images, not its scene, to anyone who has it; unlink revokes them all. report sends one version to Zindex support. feedback sends Zindex staff a bug, docs (the docs and engine disagree), request or other; id or snippet attaches a diagram. Asks the user to confirm publish, link, report and feedback.

anonymize.description: For report and feedback; default true

problem.description: For report: what is wrong, in one line

revision.description: For report or feedback; default the latest

snippet.description: A scene or Mermaid, 64 KB at most

name: diagram_share
title: Share a diagram
